sloka: सुप्तघ्नो यज्ञकोपश्च मत्तोन्मत्तौ तथैव च ।अनला चाभवत्कन्या सुन्दर्यां राम सुन्दरी ।। ७.५.३७ ॥
transliteration: suptaghno yajñakopaśca mattonmattau tathaiva ca ।analā cābhavatkanyā sundaryāṁ rāma sundarī ।। 7.5.37 ॥

translations.english: O Rama, from Sundari were born sons named Suptaghna, Yajñakopa, Matta, and Unmatta, and also a beautiful daughter named Anala.
